ops.text: Fridge 1311992 for the Police, in the 2-storey building. It came on 14 Oct 2026, the day it was due, with T0265's four fridges; it was put on P46 (QPS Command Post) on 15 Oct and moved here 17 Oct. Andrew, 17 Oct 2026: "1311992 - These were for the Police" ... "The ones for police can go in 2 story building are P26 & P28" ... "So did the fridges" (turned up on the correct day). Recorded on site 17 Oct; on site since 14 Oct.
